title: CRATES N' MOHAWKS
description:
A mob-spawning rift strikes the natural habitat (a scrapyard) of our deadbeat hero that is just trying to sleep and eat cold pizza on an old sofa. Realizing crates contain precious defensive mechanisms, our hero must fight to survive this hostile threat!

FEATURES

• Fast-paced action - straight to the point

• Short and sweet gameplay - each run is under 10 minutes

• Score multiplier: grab crates frantically within seconds and get extra points!

• 18 unique guns with different behaviors to cycle through

• 10 colorful enemies to give the middle finger

• 10 pickups to make surviving more manageable

• Waves increasing in challenge 'til death or glory

• More than 5 alternative game modes that can 'up' the difficulty or just make it more experimental

• Accessibility options (under custom mode): tweak some of the game numbers so that the difficulty fits you
description_short: CRATES N' MOHAWKS is a chaotic arena shooter where every crate swaps your weapon. Grab crates, adapt to constantly changing guns, dodge swarms of enemies, and survive as long as possible while pushing your score higher.
